review:
Hacksaw's take on the classic book slot – 5x3, paylines, and a Book that's both wild and scatter, with explorer Amy Dawn leading the way.

Three Books give Book of Dawn free spins, four give Triple Book of Dawn, and five also pay 1,000x on top. Pair three Books with the Best of Bonus symbol and you get Best of Book, which plays both bonus types and keeps the better result. If you know book games, you'll get it instantly. 10,000x max.
